title: Find or nullptr
prompt: Implement `find_value(const std::vector<int>& v, int target)` returning a `const int*` to the first match, or `nullptr` if absent.

tests.name: found
tests.code: std::vector<int> v{4, 8, 15}; const int* r = find_value(v, 8); CHECK(r && *r == 8);

tests.name: absent
tests.hint: Missing → nullptr, not a dangling pointer.
